name: starters
description: General-purpose examples offered above an empty room's composer: each shows something an agent can do in a room, from a page you can preview to a plan, a summary or a diagram.

prompts.title: Build a landing page
prompts.body: Build a one-page landing page for a neighborhood coffee shop that I can preview here.

prompts.title: Write a project plan
prompts.body: Write a project plan for launching a community podcast as a Markdown document: goals, milestones, owners and risks.

prompts.title: Explain an idea
prompts.body: Explain this idea in five short bullet points for someone new to it:

prompts.title: Summarize a document
prompts.body: Summarize the document I attach: the key points, the decisions and the open questions, on one page.

prompts.title: Draw a diagram
prompts.body: Draw a simple diagram of how an online order travels from the customer to the kitchen.
